answer: Draw an agent jury from numbered units of locked collateral, never from account names. Freeze ownership before a random beacon, then sample units without replacement. If zephyr splits its hundred units between opal and harbor accounts, its total chance of selection stays the same. Conflicting signed votes for one case burn the selected unit, which remains locked through the dispute window. Extra keys buy no extra tickets; an attacker must acquire and risk more collateral. Wealth concentration remains a weakness.
